'''Jaquilinbella-bessamarte''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She and her partner, [[Rikkimikvonsantikki the Fifty-Fourth]], were foster [[Parent/Legends|parents]] for the [[Pacithhip/Legends|Pacithhip]] [[Shnozitskigante-maximilliana]].<ref name="Lone Wolf" />
